descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · S09 Dictate → Stop → review → Save Note: the app passes the engine's text through unchanged

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Dictated numbers (doses, lab values, vital signs) are transcribed exactly: same value, nothing dropped, added or changed. (UAT TC-23; TFA-94423 AC 3)
  • T6 No dictated fact is silently dropped (Principle 2), including the last words before Stop and the words around an interruption or a recovery. (TFA-94229 R9) — gate: blocked: TFA-94229 in progress

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Tim's chromium tests with a stubbed recogniser (on-device test marker): one Hospital patient, one Nursing Home resident

When Hospital: dictate 'Admitted for pneumonia, oxygen 94 percent, creatinine 1.4.' into the pre-round box, Stop, Save Note. Nursing Home: dictate 'Check orthostatic blood pressure.' into Important Points and tap Stop while the last words are still arriving

Then Hospital: the box and the saved preRoundNotes equal the dictated text exactly. Nursing Home: Save Note stays disabled until the final words arrive, then the field equals the phrase exactly

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright: toHaveValue(dictatedText) and preRoundNotes toBe(dictatedText), numbers 94 and 1.4 included (U1, app half); NH toHaveValue(phrase) with Save disabled until the final words arrive (T6). The recogniser is a stub, not GPT-live, so this proves only that the app does not alter or drop the text it receives

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S09 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-23.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16/17 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-23/S09

Dictate → Stop → review → Save Note: the app passes the engine's text through unchanged

Tickets: TFA-94229 Port & preserve Vikram's clinical AI logic (in progress); TFA-94423 Implement GPT-live medical mode for active dictation (ready for qa)

Result: passed in matrix/TC-23.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • chart.spec.ts [chromium] — on-device dictation is reviewable and saved — expected
  • dictation-completion.spec.ts [chromium] — nursing-home Important Points block Save Note until their final words arrive — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's chromium specs in e2e/chart.spec.ts and e2e/dictation-completion.spec.ts): fresh @roundai.test accounts made through e2e/support with the local admin key, and the recogniser is the installSpeechRecognitionMock stub (on-device test marker); dev has no admin key, no stub and one share…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
